text:
maria_cs: Quick weekly check-in for Nexus private deployment (please drop region notes). TL;DR: overall stable but saw a few KMS handshakes in ap-south and a latency bump in eu-west overnight. Can people post short status + actions? :eyes:

devon_infra: eu-west-1 saw a sustained p95 jump from ~110ms -> ~260ms between 02:10-03:05 UTC. Cause looks like autoscaler rebalanced pods across AZs (bursty churn). Mitigated by pinning instance group; p95 back to ~120ms. Will follow up with autoscaling tweak. :thumbsup:

liam_sre: ap-south-1 KMS handshakes failing intermittently. Root cause: customer VPN IP change broke HSM allowlist for one subnet. Error from the agent: ```ERROR KMS_HANDSHAKE: TLS alert unknown CA; remote=10.4.12.9:443``` We opened support ticket #CS-5821 for HSM vendor. Temporary workaround: route KMS traffic via us-east private bridge for affected zone.

sophia_custeng: Noted — I already notified the customer's security team about the IP change and asked them to verify HSM allowlist. They're also asking for an audit log showing retries and failure windows for renewal discussion. Can we produce a 48h CSV?

devon_infra: yes, I can export logs. Quick command I'm going to run: ```curl -s "https://internal-logs.local/nexus/kms?start=2024-10-18T00:00Z&end=2024-10-20T00:00Z" -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' > nexus_kms_48h.csv``` I'll drop the file in the shared drive and ping the customer.

maria_cs: thanks. On spend/usage — Nexus token spend is +18% wk/wk due to cache miss rate increase after the autoscaler churn. Suggest enabling prefix caching for two large routes (chat/stream and rerank) as a short-term cost control. Who owns that change?

devon_infra: i can toggle caching flags, but want to coordinate with app owners. Will open change request CR-1079 targeting Tue 09:00 UTC to enable prefix caching on a canary set (20% traffic) first.

liam_sre: also adding a small circuit-breaker on the KMS path so we don't pile up retries during handshake failures. Patch onboarded to staging; running soak now. If green, will deploy to prod during low traffic window tonight 01:30 UTC.

sophia_custeng: renewal impact note: customer is asking about SLA credits because of the ap-south blips. The blips are caused by CV change on their side, but we should prepare a short incident timeline and mitigations to include in the renewal pack. I can draft language, need log export (Devon) + patch ETA (Liam).

maria_cs: action list: 1) Devon: export nexus_kms_48h.csv and share link (due EOD) 2) Liam: circuit-breaker rollout plan + deploy ETA (due tonight) 3) Devon & App owners: CR-1079 canary prefix-caching (schedule Tue 09:00 UTC) 4) Sophia: draft renewal note + attach log and mitigation timeline (due tomorrow 12:00 UTC). Add reactions when done.

deploy-bot: Build succeeded for release/infra-patches @ 2024-10-20T00:58:12Z :white_check_mark: (sha: a1b2c3d)

devon_infra: done exporting logs, link: https://files.redwood.internal/nexus_kms_48h.csv (internal only) — pinged customer security. :email:

liam_sre: circuit-breaker deploy succeeded to prod at 2024-10-20T01:36Z. Observability: KMS retry queue depth down ~85% in affected zone. No regressions seen in canary.

maria_cs: great. Sophia — can you draft the renewal language and include the mitigation timeline + the csv link? If you want, I can scrub it for tone before it goes to the account exec.

sophia_custeng: on it. I'll post draft here by 2024-10-20 14:00 UTC. Also asking customer for confirmation of allowlist change ETA (they indicated COB tomorrow).

liam_sre: follow-up note: recommend we add a runbook entry for "KMS handshake: customer IP change" with steps: verify allowlist, route via bridge, enable circuit-breaker. I'll add PR to runbook repo.

maria_cs: perfect. No new Sev. Closing this check-in — please react when your items are done. :v:
